headline: Reporting network vantages combine to a 28.3% interference index
dek: The fusion names excluded and divergent inputs instead of silently averaging away disagreement.

claims.statement: The current coverage-weighted fusion of reporting vantages is 28.3%.

method.summary: coverage-weighted mean of vantages normalized to 0-100 (Censored Planet remote interference rate, OONI in-country anomaly index); agreement = 1 − |OONI − CP| / 60pp; CONTESTED when the two differ > 20pp; net4people blocking-event share adjusts confidence only.

limitations: The fused index summarizes differently sampled methods and is not a direct percentage of China's internet traffic.
